name: portal-app
_build_output_note: Firebase Hosting serves portal-app/build at the site ROOT, so assets live at /static/* (root firebase.json caches /static/** immutably). Vite's defaults are dist/ + assets/, so vite.config.js overrides build.outDir/assetsDir to keep the deploy contract from CRA unchanged. `base` must stay '/' - the router basename is /diya-ed, but that is a URL prefix only, not a directory on the host (issue #421).
_overrides_note: firebase@10 pins undici to exactly 6.19.7, which carries a batch of high-severity advisories (GHSA-c76h-2ccp-4975 and friends). undici is only reachable from @firebase/*'s Node builds - it is not in the browser bundle this app ships - but it still fails `npm audit --audit-level=high`, which the CI dependency-audit job blocks on as of #503. Pinning forward within undici 6.x clears it without a firebase major bump.
